issue.title: Task backlog epic 3: publication safety, handoffs, check coverage, and state freshness
issue.description: Fix and close the five selected fleet-costly task beads, then continue the backlog chain under the same ranking and closeout rules.

issue.title: Scan and safely recover prompt migrations into the agents sidecar (sase-1os)
issue.description: prompt-migration-protection: route the one-time legacy prompt migration through the shared publication-protection scanner before staging, and stop recommending a raw push after a GH013 rejection. Preserve the existing private/quarantine behavior and sanitized diagnostics. Add regression coverage for clean migration, a detected secret, and a rejected push; ensure no secret value is emitted or replayed.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/task_backlog_epic_3.md defines phase prompt-migration-protection as one work unit

issue.title: Keep long-waiting bead agents alive when their dependency wakes (sase-12v)
issue.description: waiter-wake-recovery: reproduce the wake-time NameCollisionError after a long wait, identify the reservation or retry failure, and make the wake path recover or retry safely without launching duplicate successors. Preserve the original dependency and workspace state. Review the related sase-1el monitor-start report, but do not assume a shared root cause from the exception class alone.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/task_backlog_epic_3.md defines phase waiter-wake-recovery as one work unit

issue.title: Select agent-artifact marker audits for marker-writer changes (sase-1mv)
issue.description: marker-audit-selection: make scoped test selection include both AST audit modules when a changed source file writes a tracked agent-artifact marker, without exceeding the contract-set serial budget or weakening the audits. Add selector regression tests and show that a marker-writer change selects both audits.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/task_backlog_epic_3.md defines phase marker-audit-selection as one work unit

issue.title: Remove the full-check timeout for the empty-home SDD identity test (sase-120)
issue.description: sdd-identity-check-flake: reproduce the repeated full-lane timeout and passing isolated run for test_sdd_git_identity_survives_empty_home_subprocess. Determine whether the nested subprocess or the temporary-directory leak guard causes the slow/failing result, then fix isolation or cleanup without weakening the test or simply extending its timeout. Verify the node, its file, and the scoped/full check.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/task_backlog_epic_3.md defines phase sdd-identity-check-flake as one work unit

issue.title: Publish terminal agent-run state instead of leaving thousands of rows active (sase-1cc)
issue.description: published-run-state-freshness: ensure a completed or failed run in a published hood eventually updates the agents-sidecar state snapshot. Choose a reliable terminal-publication or reconciliation path, account for concurrent hood publication, and provide a safe bounded backfill plan for existing stale rows. Verify terminal-state convergence and that live runs are not marked terminal.
